name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent near the Nürburgring. He pursued a degree in communications with a focus on motorsport public relations. His journey began with an internship at a smaller racing team, where he quickly proved his ability to craft compelling narratives and manage media relations effectively. He is now a valuable asset to Proton by Premotion, bringing a data-driven approach to PR, constantly analyzing media trends to optimize outreach. 

Maximilian stands out due to his creative approach to PR, blending traditional methods with innovative digital strategies. He believes in building genuine relationships with journalists and fans alike, understanding that authentic communication is key to long-term success. His loyalty and dedication to the team are unparalleled; he sees himself as an integral part of their journey, committed to elevating their brand on and off the track.

His distinctive strength lies in his ability to translate complex technical information into easily digestible content for a broader audience. This skill is invaluable in bridging the gap between the engineering aspects of motorsport and the public's understanding, ensuring that Proton by Premotion's achievements are celebrated and appreciated by a wide range of followers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height, with a sharp, focused gaze that conveys his dedication.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with media contacts and story ideas.
Has a peculiar habit of organizing his desk according to the racing schedule.
Insists on starting every team briefing with a motivational quote, often from a famous racing driver.
